fusions.name: Springing Nip
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles onto a target and deals 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Bounding Squalls
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you is caught by a gust that deals 7 damage, and you move 15% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Over the Table
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Height of the Hop
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next ability deals 20% more damage. Once every 5 seconds.
